title: Proto A Development Pipeline: Programming, Testing, Bug Fixing
purpose: Define a repeatable pipeline for using Prototype A (JSONL + SQLite WAL) coordination to drive actual development work through programming, testing, and bug fixing stages — with cross-team coordination via think tanks, external research, and data archival.
scope: Any development task coordinated through Proto A multi-agent teams
anti_recursion_check: This SOP produces domain artifacts (code, tests, fixes, reports) — NOT more coordination infrastructure. If >40% of work items are about the coordination system itself, STOP and rebalance.

roles.think-tank-alpha: Plan analysis — decompose features into work items, define acceptance criteria, identify risks. Consumes research team findings.
roles.think-tank-beta: Verification and convergence — review outputs from dev teams, validate fixes, cross-reference research, produce consolidated reports.

think_tanks.coordination: Both think tanks publish to topic channel 'think-tank-findings'. They consume from research team channels and dev team progress broadcasts.

roles.research-ext-1: External research on implementation patterns, best practices, API documentation, and library usage relevant to current work items.
roles.research-ext-2: External research on testing strategies, bug patterns, edge cases, and regression prevention relevant to current work items.

research_teams.coordination: Research teams publish findings to topic channel 'research-findings'. They pull work items from the shared work queue (priority: research tasks from think tanks).

roles.data-archive: Process and archive all team outputs. Maintain knowledge base entries. Feed processed data to think tanks. Update index files. Produce session logs.

data_archive_team.coordination: Subscribes to all topic channels. Writes to knowledge-base/entries/ and teams/ directories. Publishes archive confirmations on 'archive-status' channel.

roles.dev-prog: Programming team — implements features from work queue.
roles.dev-test: Testing team — writes and runs tests against implementations.
roles.dev-fix: Bug fix team — addresses failures found by testing team.

dev_teams.coordination: Dev teams use work stealing queue. Progress broadcast on 'dev-progress' channel. Blockers reported on 'topic-blockers'.

pipeline_stages.name: research_and_plan
pipeline_stages.description: Research teams gather external information. Think Tank Alpha decomposes the objective into work items with acceptance criteria.
pipeline_stages.done_when: Work queue has prioritized items AND research findings published

pipeline_stages.name: programming
pipeline_stages.description: Dev-prog teams steal work items and implement. Research teams continue feeding findings. Data-archive begins processing.
pipeline_stages.done_when: All priority work items claimed and implemented

pipeline_stages.name: testing
pipeline_stages.description: Dev-test team writes and executes tests. Think Tank Beta begins verification. Bugs filed back to work queue.
pipeline_stages.done_when: All implementations tested AND bugs filed

pipeline_stages.name: bug_fixing
pipeline_stages.description: Dev-fix team addresses bugs. Research-ext-2 provides fix strategies. Think Tank Beta re-verifies.
pipeline_stages.done_when: All critical/high bugs fixed AND re-verified

pipeline_stages.name: convergence_and_archive
pipeline_stages.description: Think tanks produce final report. Data-archive creates KB entries and session log. Pipeline results consolidated.
pipeline_stages.done_when: Session log written AND KB entries created AND indexes updated

iteration.description: After stage 5, the pipeline can loop back to stage 1 with lessons learned feeding the next iteration.
iteration.trigger: Remaining work items in queue OR new objectives identified during convergence
iteration.between_iterations: Think Tank Alpha reviews prior iteration report, re-prioritizes remaining work, research teams shift focus based on gaps identified.

metrics.domain_artifact_ratio: Track (domain artifacts produced) / (total artifacts). Must be > 0.6.
metrics.bug_escape_rate: Bugs found in iteration N+1 that should have been caught in iteration N.
metrics.research_utilization: Percentage of research findings referenced in implementations.
